maddeler.e:
نتكالم (form VI)
# نَتَكَالَمُ (natakālamu) /na.ta.kaː.la.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَالَمَ (takālama)
# نَتَكَالَمَ (natakālama) /na.ta.kaː.la.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَالَمَ (takālama)
# نَتَكَالَمْ (natakālam) /na.ta.kaː.lam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَالَمَ (takālama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
